name: Generosity

definition_by_age.6: Generosity means giving to others even when you could keep something for yourself.
definition_by_age.8: Generosity is giving time, things, or help to others sincerely, without expecting anything back.

learning_objective: Children can name something they shared and how it felt.

recommended_default.note: Retrieval ranking (retrieval_ranking.md) starts from this combination and diversity-penalizes away from it on repeat use, per recommended_story_combinations.md.

hd_007.reasoning: Directly on-topic generosity hadith — the giving hand is better than the taking hand.

alternative_patterns.reasoning: Not wanting to share the last snack is a genuine two-wants-collide negotiation.
